items.event_time_ist: ~2:00 PM IST, Oct 21 (SEM surety-reconsideration hearing, Mandir Marg)
items.title: Delhi Police seeks 3 more days of judicial custody for Das and Ranka at today's SEM hearing; decision still pending
items.summary: At the 2 PM IST surety-reconsideration hearing before the Special Executive Magistrate at Mandir Marg PS — the hearing the Delhi HC told the duo to await when they withdrew their writ plea this morning — Delhi Police sought THREE more days of judicial custody for CJP co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka in the Jantar Mantar trespass/peace-bond-breach case (2 FIRs, now with the Crime Branch Inter-State Cell). CJP legal head Ratna Singh was present ahead of proceedings. The IANS report (Oct 21) says the hearing was still underway and the magistrate had not yet pronounced a decision as of ~6 PM IST. No second news outlet is carrying the 3-day request yet; an IG news graphic the same evening corroborates the headline. Also today at the HC: Justice Subramonium Prasad withdrew the duo's plea with the oral remarks 'Then you are not Gen Z' (told Das, 27, and Ranka, 32) and 'Earlier it was a student protest; children were there, but now it's another cause' — color from the same hearing, not re-alerted as a separate arc.
